english.title: Fail to comply with a restriction on construction of bridges over a highway
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[constructed a bridge over a highway, namely **(..SPECIFY HIGHWAY..) at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) without a licence under section 176 of the Highways Act 1980]_
(B)_[constructed a bridge over a highway, namely **(..SPECIFY HIGHWAY..) at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) otherwise than in accordance with the terms and conditions of a licence under section 176 of the Highways Act 1980 in that **(..SPECIFY BREACH..)]_
(C)_[used a bridge over a highway, namely **(..SPECIFY HIGHWAY..) at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) otherwise than in accordance with the terms and conditions of a licence under section 176 of the Highways Act 1980 in that **(..SPECIFY BREACH..)]_
(D)_[failed to remove a bridge over a highway, namely **(..SPECIFY HIGHWAY..) at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) when required to do so in accordance with the terms and conditions of a licence under section 176 of the Highways Act 1980 in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)]_
(E)_[failed to alter a bridge over a highway, namely **(..SPECIFY HIGHWAY..) at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) when required to do so in accordance with the terms and conditions of a licence under section 176 of the Highways Act 1980 in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)]_
(F)_[failed to remove a bridge over a highway, namely **(..SPECIFY HIGHWAY..) at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) within one month of the expiration of a licence under section 176 of the Highways Act 1980]_
(G)_[failed to alter a bridge over a highway, namely **(..SPECIFY HIGHWAY..) at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) within one month of the expiration of a licence under section 176 of the Highways Act 1980]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 176(7) of the Highways Act 1980.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Proceedings for this offence shall not without the written consent of the Attorney General, be taken by any person other than the person aggrieved, or a highway authority or council having an interest in the enforcement of the provision or byelaws in question - section 312 Highways Act 1980.
(ii) The meaning of "highway" is defined in section 328 Highways Act 1980.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level two on the standard scale and if the offence is continued after conviction he is guilty of a further offence and to a further fine of £5 for each day on which the offence continues.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
